device.description: TThe device to which VGT model will be processed on, e.g. "cuda", "cpu".

modelDefinitionZip.description: The external URL of the configuration zip file for the layout parser.

documentHierarchyParserSpec.description:
Enable the document hierarchy parser
Define the document hierarchy parser spec. If not provided, the default spec will be used.
If set to null, the document hierarchy parser will be disabled.

boundingBoxClassList.description:
The full list of bounding box classes of the document layout analysis model.
This needs to match the output class space of the model.

boundingBoxFilterDict.description:
Dictionary to filter bounding boxes with low predicted scores. The values
should be between 0 to 1. This dictionary should have all the values from
bounding_box_class_list.

doNotGenerateGrid.description:
Do not generate grid for VGT. Note: VGT will have slightly worse performance
in the absence of the grid.

pdfplumberToImageKwargs.description: Keyword arguments to be used when calling pdfplumber.to_image().

intraclassConsolidationDict.description:
A dictionary to merge homogeneous bounding box classes. The keys are the final
classes to be stored, and the values are lists of VGT output classes. Can merge
certain homogeneous VGT output classes into one. Note: if a VGT output class is
not in any of the dictionary's value lists, the bounding boxes of that class will be ignored.

interclassConsolidationDict.description:
A dictionary to merge heterogeneous bounding box classes. The keys are the target classes,
and the values are lists of source classes to be merged.

findPageSeparators.description: Whether to find page separators to support multi-column documents.

gridStep.description: The step (in pixels) to which the process of fingind page separators creates grids for bounding box "hits".

boundarySkipRatioHorizontal.description: The ratio of horizontal boundaries to skip. This skips from both left and right.

boundarySkipRatioVertical.description: The ratio of vertical boundaries to skip. This skips from both top and bottom.

lowPassFilter.description:
The low pass threshold to determine whether a position is a separator. This needs
to work with grid_step and may need to change if grid_step is changed.

maxSeparatorsAllowed.description:
The maximum number of separators allowed on one page. If more separators than this are
detected, we see them as unreliable and do not return any separators.

gridGenerationThreadCount.description:
Number of threads to run grid generation. Multi-thread will run pages in parallel.
Default to 1. Must check the number of current threads available in nodes.

gridGenerationProcessTimeoutPerPageSecon.description:
Timeout limit of grid generation step to be spent per page. Default to 2.
If timeout, return empty grid for the page.

vgtInferenceBatchSize.description:
The batch size of data when calling VGT inference. Note: setting this to 1 is recommended
as higher value does not lead to significant latency improvement.
